title: 第十二章雨夜易杀人
novel_title: 开局阴阳宗，从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
content_zh:
阴阳门，某座屋舍内，油灯在微风的干扰下，慢慢燃烧。

    屋外的雨越下越大，不时还有几声雷声传出。

    郑雅坐在梳妆镜前，梳着头发，看着面前的镜子。

    她轻轻地哼着歌，心情不错。

    江燕那个婊子死了，没人能和师姐竞争真传了，师姐真传的位置可以说是十拿九稳了。

    到时候师姐成了真传，那自己……

    她放下梳子，整了整额头前的碎发。

    不过，江燕的那个炉鼎反倒是跑了，多留一个隐患。

    但她倒也是没有多么担忧，师姐已经以残害同门的罪行，对他发起了通缉，一个练气初期的炉鼎，怎么可能逃得过那么多人的追杀。

    她嗤笑一声，嘲笑自己想这么多，然后向床铺走去。

    她在床铺上坐下，丰盈的曲线在那若隐若现的衣服上逐渐显露，惹人联想。

    她抬起玉足，拍了拍上面的沙土，准备睡觉。

    就在这时，门外突然传出一声异响，她眉目微皱，呵斥道：“谁！”

    不过一时都没有回答。

    她提起心神，一拳握紧，眼神死死地盯着门口。

    连绵的风声打在屋外，致使门和窗户都在微微作响。

    让屋内的整个气氛都有些压抑，似乎一丝的波动都能泛起一丝涟漪。

    “风吗？”……她自言了一句。

    这时一道女声从门外传来，她才稍稍松了口气。

    “师姐，是我，下面的灵石到了。”

    “哦，你进来吧。”郑雅整了整衣服，吩咐道。

    门吱呀一声打开，走进来一位纤瘦女子，她手里拿着一个账本，来到郑雅面前，尊敬道：

    “师姐，这是下面上来的灵石账本，包括枯木村，还有其他几个村子的。”

    郑雅拿起账本看了一眼，确定了大概。

    然后问道：“那只猪妖的贡品给了吗？”

    纤瘦女子点头：“前几天都给了，不过它一直在抱怨。”

    郑雅笑了一声，随后表情冰冷：

    “它倒是事多，等过几个月，它的价值榨干以后，随便发布一个任务，找几个普通弟子去解决了。”

    到时候随便用几颗灵石，便算打发了，至于他们的死活自己可管不着。

    既没权又没实力的弟子，不就该用在这里吗。

    就像江燕那个炉鼎一样。
content_en:
Yin Yang Gate, in a certain house, the oil lamp burned slowly under the interference of the breeze.

    The rain outside the house was getting heavier and heavier, and there were a few thunders from time to time.

    Zheng Ya sat in front of the dressing mirror, combing her hair and looking at the mirror in front of her.

    She hummed softly and was in a good mood.

    That bitch Jiang Yan is dead, and no one can compete with Senior Sister for the True Legend. It can be said that Senior Sister's True Legend position is almost guaranteed.

    When the time comes when the senior sister becomes the true successor, then I...

    She put down the comb and straightened the broken hair on her forehead.

    However, Jiang Yan's cauldron ran away, leaving another hidden danger.

    But she wasn't too worried. The senior sister had already launched a wanted arrest against him for the crime of killing his fellow disciples. How could a furnace in the early stage of Qi training escape being hunted by so many people.

    She scoffed, laughing at herself for thinking so much, and walked towards the bed.

    She sat down on the bed, her plump curves gradually revealed on the looming clothes, which was evocative.

    She raised her jade feet, patted the sand on them, and prepared to sleep.

    At this moment, there was a sudden noise outside the door. She frowned slightly and yelled: "Who!"

    But there was no answer for a while.

    She raised her mind, clenched her fist, and stared at the door.

    Continuous wind blew outside the house, causing the doors and windows to rattle slightly.

    The entire atmosphere in the room was a little depressing, as if the slightest fluctuation could cause a ripple.

    "Wind?"...she said to herself.

    At this time, a female voice came from outside the door, and she relaxed a little.

    "Senior sister, it's me. The spiritual stone below has arrived."

    "Oh, come in." Zheng Ya straightened her clothes and ordered.

    The door creaked open, and a slender woman walked in. She came to Zheng Ya with a ledger in her hand and said respectfully:

    "Senior sister, this is the Lingshi account book that came up from below, including Kumu Village and several other villages."

    Zheng Ya picked up the account book and took a look at it to make sure.

    Then he asked: "Did you give the pig demon a tribute?"

    The slender woman nodded: "I gave it a few days ago, but it kept complaining."

    Zheng Ya laughed, then her expression was cold:

    "It has a lot of things to do. After a few months, and its value is drained, I can randomly issue a task and find a few ordinary disciples to solve it."

    At that time, just use a few spirit stones and it will be considered as a waste. As for their life and death, I have no control over them.

    Disciples who have neither power nor strength should be used here.

    Just like Jiang Yan's furnace.
title_en: Chapter 12 It’s easy to kill someone on a rainy night
